items.stem: Privacy by design means that privacy is:

options.text: Built into systems and processes from the outset
options.rationale: Correct: privacy by design embeds privacy from the start, not as an afterthought.

options.text: Added only after a breach occurs
options.rationale: Reactive addition is the opposite of privacy by design.

options.text: The sole responsibility of the marketing team
options.rationale: Privacy is a cross-functional, not marketing-only, concern.
Privacy by design applies to personal-data processing.

items.explanation: Correct: privacy by design embeds privacy from the start, not as an afterthought.

items.stem: Data minimization as a privacy principle requires that organizations:

options.text: Collect only the personal data necessary for a stated purpose
options.rationale: Correct: data minimization limits collection to what is necessary.

options.text: Collect as much data as technically possible

options.rationale: Retention limits are part of minimization, not indefinite storage.

options.text: Share data with any third party on request

items.explanation: Correct: data minimization limits collection to what is necessary.
